3430-3995-6006.easyPrerequisites: Horseshoe Crab doesn't have summoning sickness.
3430-3995-6006.description:
Activate Horseshoe Crab by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U} due to Nyxbloom Ancient
Activate Horseshoe Crab by paying {U}, untapping it.
Repeat.

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

728-2033-3249-4556--52.easyPrerequisites: Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-2033-3249-4556--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Citanul Hierophants by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, Blight Mound triggers, creating a creature token or a token that adds mana.
If you created a creature token, repeat steps 1 and 2 to sacrifice that token and add an additional mana.
If you created a token that adds mana, instead activate that token to add mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the sacrificed creature from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature from your graveyard by paying one mana.
Repeat.

1479-1659-2841-8101.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Wooded Foothills.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
1479-1659-2841-8101.description:
Fetch a land using Wooded Foothills.
When the fetched land enters, Seed the Land and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Seed the Land trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Seed the Land from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Seed the Land triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

1325-2511-5170-6132.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, Kheru Bloodsucker triggers, causing each opponent to lose 2 life and you to gain 2 life.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Kheru Bloodsucker trigger.
Resolve the Kheru Bloodsucker trigger, causing each opponent to lose 2 life and you to gain 2 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

2653-2893-4826-7906.description:
Activate Fertilid by paying {1}{G} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, causing you to search your library for a basic land card and put it on the battlefield untapped due to Archelos.
When the basic land enters, Nissa and Thranduil's Company trigger.
Resolve the Nissa trigger, adding {G}.
Resolve the Thranduil's Company trigger, putting two +1/+1 counters on Fertilid.
Activate the basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

215-4188-5223.notablePrerequisites: You have gained at least 6 life this turn.
215-4188-5223.description:
Activate Accomplished Alchemist by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Accomplished Alchemist from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Accomplished Alchemist by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

2452-2921-3249-5173.description:
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast Shambling Ghast card from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Shambling Ghast from your graveyard by paying {0} due to Rooftop Storm.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Shambling Ghast.
When Shambling Ghast dies, it triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and without a -1/-1 counter on it

3099-3129-4029-4762.description:
Activate Leyline of Abundance by paying {6}{G}{G}, putting four +1/+1 counters on each creature you control due to Benevolent Hydra and Primal Vigor.
Activate Devoted Druid's first ability by tapping it, adding {G}.
Leyline of Abundance triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping Devoted Druid.
Repeat from step 2 three additional times.
Repeat from step 1.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and with three or more charge counters on it

1978-4241-4563.description:
Animate Everflowing Chalice using Karn.
Activate Everflowing Chalice by tapping it, adding at least {C}{C}{C}
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Everflowing Chalice.
Repeat from step 2.

2866-2921-4211-4986.description:
Cast Tormod's Crypt by paying its mana cost.
Teshar triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Tormod's Crypt by tapping and sacrificing it.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Scrap Trawler.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Tormod's Crypt from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

437-1379-1651-5640.description:
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping it and Sphinx's Disciple, targeting Sphinx's Disciple.
Ertha Jo triggers, copying Clock of Omens' ability, targeting Clock of Omens.
Resolve both Clock of Omens  abilities, untapping it and Sphinx's Disciple.
Sphinx's Disciple triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

478-2404-6871.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three creatures.
478-2404-6871.description:
Activate Gaea's Cradle by tapping it, adding {G} for each creature you control.
Activate Candelabra of Tawnos by paying {2} and tapping it, untapping Gaea's Cradle and Candelabra of Tawnos as it is a land due to Toph.
Repeat.

1850-5411-5967.description:
Activate Need for Speed by sacrificing a land.
Play the land from your graveyard.
Repeat.
1850-5411-5967.notes: If the land can tap for mana once it enters the battlefield, you can do so for infinite mana.

1308-2457-4289-4785.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate two Insects by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat

2058-2073-5226.description:
Activate Salvaging Station by tapping it, returning Flayer Husk from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Flayer Husk enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 0/0 Phyrexian Germ creature token and attaching Flayer Husk to it.
Activate Lithatog by sacrificing Flayer Husk.
The Phyrexian Germ dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness, triggering Salvaging Station, untapping Salvaging Station.
Resolve the Lithatog ability.
Repeat.

1409-4365-6348.notablePrerequisites: You control a Dragon and/or have a Dragon card in hand.
1409-4365-6348.description:
Activate Sarkhan by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Sarkhan enters the battlefield, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger.
Resolve the Sarkhan trigger, either choosing a Dragon you control or revealing a Dragon card from your hand and creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Sarkhan.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

2292-2835-6249--5.notablePrerequisites: The persist creature does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
2292-2835-6249--5.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, it and Fecundity trigger.
Resolve the Fecundity trigger, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the persist creature's trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters the battlefield, Olivia triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature and causing you to discard a card.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

1987-3277-4276-4823.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {4}{U}{U}{U}.
1987-3277-4276-4823.description:
Activate any number of lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{U}{U}.
Cast Turnabout by paying {2}{U}{U}, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Timeless Witness and Izzet Chronarch.
When Timeless Witness and Izzet Chronarch enter the battlefield, they trigger, returning Turnabout and Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
1987-3277-4276-4823.notes: If lands you control can tap to produce at least {5}{U}{U}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana. You can then stop casting Turnabout and blink one other permanent using Ghostly Flicker. You may also tap artifacts and/or creatures instead for mana if desired.

uses.n: The Enigma Jewel // Locus of Enlightenment

74-943-1671.description:
Activate Simic Growth Chamber by tapping it, adding {G}{U}.
Activate Deserted Temple's second ability by paying {1} and tapping it, targeting itself.
Locus of Enlightenment triggers, copying Deserted Temple's ability, targeting Simic Growth Chamber.
Resolve both Deserted Temple abilities, untapping it and Simic Growth Chamber.
Repeat.
74-943-1671.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may untap any other land except Simic Growth Chamber instead.

3490-3880-4659.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional artifact.
3490-3880-4659.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing another artifact, adding {C}{C}.
Ravenous Squirrel triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.

2558-4139-4659.description:
Activate Thopter Foundry by paying {1} and sacrificing Sword of the Meek, creating a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token and gaining 1 life.
The Thopter token enters the battlefield, triggering Sword of the Meek, returning Sword of the Meek to the battlefield equipped to the Thopter.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Thopter token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.
